From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Greywood Labs onboarding intake — MOP, technical constraints & steward assignment

Hi team —

Quick handoff for the Greywood Labs win (GW-2026-142). Summary and asks below so CS and implementation can pick up the thread.

Deal snapshot
- ARR: $225k (year 1)
- Seats: 250 internal users; pilot group 25
- Product: Hosted API + Dedicated capacity (they elected reserved pool)
- Go-live target: Phase 1 pilot by 2027-01-31, production rollout Q2 2027
- Champion: Dr. Samuel Rhodes (CTO)
- Procurement lead: procure@greywoodlabs.com

Key constraints / requirements called out in the contract
- Data residency: US-only; they must host logs in us-east-1 (customer requirement)
- Compliance: require SOC 2 Type II evidence (we have SOC 2 reports in Drive)
- Network: IP allowlist + static egress for dedicated pool; they will provide firewall team contact
- Integrations: SFTP batch ingest nightly + API for real-time transforms; sample dataset attached (sample-dataset-specs.csv)
- Volume expectations: pilot ~20k tokens/day; production ~2.5M tokens/day (spiky, heavy batch overnight)

Risks / open items
1) Sandbox credentials: Greywood needs a sandbox org for security review before we grant dedicated capacity.
2) Network windows: firewall change lead time is 5–10 business days; procurement requested earliest start 2026-12-15.
3) Ingest format: they asked for UTF-8 CSV with PII redaction pre-ingest — need to confirm whether Redwood handles redaction or they will provide sanitized files.

Attachments sent with this email: GW-SOW-v1.pdf, network-and-security-questions.xlsx, sample-dataset-specs.csv

Asks for CS / Implementation
- Can we schedule a technical intake with Greywood's infra/security team next week (please propose 2 slots)?
- Assign primary Implementation PM and a Technical Owner for dedicated pool set up.
- Confirm sandbox org timeline and who will own the sandbox provisioning.

Internal notes: procurement expects final signature by 2026-11-30 if we can present sandbox / security answers by 2026-11-26.

Thanks — I’ll stay on to introduce during the kickoff.

-Priyom
Priyom Das

Quick answers / clarifying Qs before we set intake: 
- Tessa, would you accept the Implementation PM role for the pilot and own the dedicated pool provisioning?
- Sam / Alicia (Greywood) — can you confirm the security review scope: is it just SOC 2 evidence + firewall IPs, or do you expect an on-site audit?
- For PII redaction: do you have a legal or privacy point of contact who can confirm the approach?

Two scheduling asks:
1) Security & infra intake (30–45m): propose Tue 2026-11-24 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 2026-11-24 14:00–14:45 PT — pick one.
2) Kickoff with product and stakeholders: week of 11/29.

I’ll prepare a starter MOP doc (owners, milestones, acceptance criteria) and drop it in the shared Drive link. Tessa — if you confirm, I’ll add roles and draft a 6-week pilot plan.

-Marissa

Marissa —

Thanks. Answers below inline: 

> Tessa, would you accept the Implementation PM role for the pilot and own the dedicated pool provisioning?
- Yes, procurement flagged 12/15 earliest work window; we need to lock a provisioning date. I recommend Tessa lead coordination with infra.

> Security review scope?
- Greywood confirmed via Alicia that they need: SOC 2 evidence, network allowlist, and a snapshot of our logging/retention policies. No on-site audit requested as of now. Alicia: please confirm if anything else is needed.

> PII redaction owner?
- Greywood legal (cc’d) will own final decision. Sam indicated they prefer to send pre-redacted files, but asked if Redwood can provide a small redaction utility as an interim step. I flagged to Legal that this may be out of scope for pilot.

Other notes:
- Sandbox: I created a sandbox request ticket with infra; they said provisioning takes 2 business days once we supply the environment name and allowed IPs.
- HubSpot: deal page updated (link below).

I’ll join the intake.

-Priyom

Looping in a couple technical clarifications from Eng/Ops side.

1) Dedicated pool: based on projected production volume (2.5M tokens/day with overnight batch), I recommend we provision a 2-card Quadro pool for pilot staging and a 4-card pool for production. That maps to our cost model in the SOW; please confirm budget acceptance.

2) IPs & egress: we need a definitive list of egress IPs for their allowlist. If they need static egress from their VPC, the Dedicated team requires a ticket with the target CIDR.

3) Monitoring & alerts: suggest we enable token-level billing and latency dashboards in Redwood Console for the pilot and set a soft-usage alert at 200k tokens/day during pilot.

Attached: network-and-security-questions.xlsx (I filled in preliminary port and IP guidance).

Ben Carter
